newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it killed 30 Kurd rebels in southeast.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it killed 30 Kurd rebels in southeast.

text.p: Thirty Kurdish rebels and four soldiers have died in separate clashes in Turkey's southeast, the emergency rule governor's office said in a statement on Wednesday.
Security forces killed 30 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels in Siirt, Tunceli, Batman and Bingol provinces and four soldiers died in the fighting in Siirt, the statement said.
It did not say when the clashes took place.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict between troops and the PKK, fighting for autonomy or independence in the country's mainly Kurdish southeast.
